player_prompt.intro:
I yɛ Jokɛla {player_id}. I yɛ tɔgɔ Kɔnɔkɛla.
I bɛ tɔgɔ kɔnɔ min kɛ {min_number} ne {max_number} kɔnɔ {max_turns} kɛ.
O kɛ i tɔgɔ i kɔnɔ, dasɛn bɛ na i fɔlɔ fɛ 'kɛlɛ' wa 'tɛ'.
I bɛ na i tɔgɔ i kɔnɔ kɛlɛkɛla. I kɛ i tɔgɔ kɔnɔ yen bɛ kɛ fɔlɔ kɛ [ ]. Fɛrɛ, [5].
O kɛ i tɔgɔ, i kɔnɔkɛla bɛ taa kɛlɛkɛla kɔnɔ. I bɛ na i kɔnɔ fɛ fɔlɔ kɛ i tɔgɔ dasɛn kɛ i kɔnɔ. Kɛnɛ i kɔnɔ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Sira niɛɛ don. Jokɛla {player_id} ma tɔgɔ '[number]' yen.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Invalid move. Player {player_id} guessed a number outside the range specified.
invalid_move.already_guessed: Invalid move. Player {player_id} has already guessed the number.

outcome.win: I ye nimɔrɔ min sɔrɔ, o bɛnna.
outcome.turn_limit: The turn limit has been reached. Guess: {guess}, Target: {target}
